title: petactionbar
summary: MSUI implements the bounded production repairs and strong draw/state/input telemetry while retaining the existing packed core, horizontal seats, assignment model, token art, high-resolution portrait, and always-on bottom multibars. The preserved MSUI pet portrait is physically interactive: an empty-cursor left click targets, a right click opens current Benilla's PET menu, and dropping a held item takes the exact Feed Pet path. PetFrame and the pet's press-latched world model share the reference three-gate validator (summoned by a spell, created by the local player, learned Effect[0] 0x65), send bare CMSG_CAST_SPELL with TARGET_FLAG_ITEM and the food guid, impose no client range gate, preserve the cursor on every refusal, and clear it only after a successful send. Pet dialogs use the shared rule-owned StaticPopup coordinator, including the two-slot rename chain and exact abandon/dismiss/rename wire contracts. Ctrl-1..Ctrl-0 drive the ten pet buttons with the reference down/up latch, and Lock ActionBars gates drag-start/drop while Shift-click remains available. Protected MSUI presentation remains untouched. Connected live-session render/diff and user-visible proof remain open.
